customer_checkout_controls: Upload the controlled archive without renaming or editing CAM layers.
Select the stated layer count, thickness, copper, finish and stackup for each board.
For PCB-MAIN, select epoxy resin via filling and copper capping for all 76 controlled locations and include the controlled CSV/order remark.
Resolve every upload-parser or DFM error before payment; do not approve an automatic geometry repair that changes copper, drills, outline, POFV or polarity.
Download and compare the job-specific production files with the controlled Gerber, drill, outline and special-process notes, then confirm them in the factory portal.
Record order number, selected options, production-file checksum and any factory engineering message in the order record.
post_build_evt_validation: PCB-MAIN RF and GNSS/cellular/LoRa installed VSWR, sensitivity and coexistence
PCB-PWR rail drop, inrush, transient, thermal, cold start, protection and EMI
PCB-MIC acoustic-port inspection, phase, gain, noise and delay calibration
First-article SPI/AOI/X-ray disposition and functional test before releasing the remaining lot
